review_candidates.description: Company Description The Egyptian Ministry of Interior is a central government body responsible for public safety, security, and infrastructure supporting national operations. The Ministry oversees the planning, development, and maintenance of critical facilities and systems across the country. Its technical departments manage complex construction and engineering projects that require robust mechanical, electrical, and plumbing solutions. Joining the Ministry offers opportunities to contribute to high-impact public sector projects, collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, and support national infrastructure development. Role Description This is a full-time, on-site MEP Project Engineer role based in Cairo, Egypt. The MEP Project Engineer will oversee the design, coordination, and implementation of mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems for Ministry facilities and projects. Daily responsibilities include reviewing technical drawings, specifications, and calculations; coordinating with architects, civil engineers, contractors, and vendors; and ensuring that MEP systems meet safety codes, regulatory standards, and project requirements. The role involves monitoring construction progress, conducting site inspections, addressing technical issues, and supporting testing, commissioning, and handover of MEP systems. The engineer will also assist with project planning, cost estimation, scheduling, and reporting to ensure timely and efficient project delivery. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Mechanical Electrical and Plumbing (MEP) expertise, with experience integrating systems in building and infrastructure projects. Candidates should possess solid Mechanical Engineering skills, including HVAC design, load calculations, equipment selection, and system optimization. Candidates should possess sound Electrical Engineering skills, including power distribution, lighting, low-current systems, and compliance with electrical safety standards. Candidates should possess Plumbing skills covering water supply, drainage, fire protection systems, and related design and installation practices. Candidates should possess Project Management skills, including planning, scheduling, resource coordination, risk management, and progress reporting. Relevant bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related discipline. Experience in building services, public sector projects, or large-scale facilities in Egypt or the region is beneficial. Proficiency in relevant design and coordination software (e.g., AutoCAD, BIM tools), and familiarity with local and international codes and standards. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary teams and on active construction sites.
